rationale: C304 fired because asset_class carried CASH_EQUIVALENT, but the raw schedule explicitly groups the relevant section as money market funds included in cash equivalents and restricted cash equivalents. The source therefore supports the cash-equivalent classification; the blocker is a controlled-vocabulary/rule-scope false alarm, not a bad row value.
